QUOTE: The library itself never calls `mbedtls_platform_set_calloc_free`. The index shows exactly one caller: `mbedtls_memory_buffer_alloc_init` (`library/memory_buffer_alloc.c:566-600`). That is the bundled fixed-buffer allocator, and it is the only in-library user of the hook.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer names the buffer allocator's init function as the sole in-library caller of the runtime setter and says it installs its own calloc/free through it. It never writes out the macro name MBEDTLS_MEMORY_BUFFER_ALLOC_C, but the allocator and the mechanism are both identified.
